portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Large cross-sectional return gaps favor selective rather than indiscriminate reversal. Taiwan and semiconductors have stronger reversal setups than persistent laggards, while energy strength has independent inflation support. Hot inflation, recent monetary tightening and weak payroll growth limit conviction. The quality scores summarize price behavior, not corporate fundamentals. Five-session returns and 21-session active returns are distinct windows; the October 28 Fed decision will already be reflected in the entry close.
